description: The plot illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with the parameter shown on the x-axis for four finetuning configurations (T5 and MBart, each with LoRA or AdaLoRA). The x-axis is labeled “log r” and appears to use a linear scale with integer tick labels spanning roughly from 1 to 8 (ticks visible at 2, 4, 6, and 8). The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” on a linear scale, ranging from about 5 up to about 40 with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: a red line (T5 + LoRA) increases steadily across the x-axis, starting near ROUGE-1 ≈24 at the leftmost point and ending near ≈37 at the rightmost point; a blue line (MBart + LoRA) starts near ≈5, rises to around ≈10, dips back near ≈6 around log r ≈2, then climbs sharply to the mid-to-high 30s by the right side (ending near ≈36–37); a green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) increases monotonically from about ≈24 at the leftmost point to about ≈39 near the rightmost point; and an orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near ≈5, rises through the teens and 20s, shows a sharp jump to the mid-30s around log r ≈3, and continues upward to around ≈40 by the rightmost point.
